svg.text: T-Display S3 → PIC18(L)F K22, LVP ICSP
Target firmware keeps LVP = 1 and MCLRE = 1. No VPP: MCLR moves only between GND (Q1) and VDD (the target's pull-up).
Same jig board: the HV parts are left off.
MCLR net: Q1 via R2 → ICSP 1
Q1 on: MCLR to VIL. Wait P18 ≥ 1 ms.
Key 4D434850h on PGD, 32 bits, MSb first.
Q1 off: pull-up lifts MCLR to VIH (P20 ≥ 40 ns).
Wait P15 ≥ 400 µs, then the usual LSb-first frames.
Exit: Q1 on (P16 ≥ 0 after the last PGC).
Not in the jig firmware yet: icsp.cpp is HV only.
